newsitem.title: USA: ABC Rail President Yorks retires.
newsitem.headline: ABC Rail President Yorks retires.

text.p: ABC Rail Products Corp., which makes replacement parts and original railroad equipment, said Tuesday that Ben Yorks, president and chief operating officer, has taken early retirement for health reasons.
Yorks will become a consultant to ABC Rail.
"The board of directors is reviewing the question of replacing Yorks," chief executive officer Donald Grinter said.
Yorks also resigned as a director of the Chicago-based company, effective immediately. The company said it will reduce the size of the board from eight to seven members.
ABC Rail's stock edged up 6.25 cents to $20 on Nasdaq shortly after midday.
